component.name: Lemma
component.summary: Write LaTeX and review an AI agent's edits inline

description.p: Lemma is a LaTeX editor built around reviewing an AI agent's edits. When the agent changes your document, every change shows up inline as a red and green hunk that you accept or reject on its own, like a code review, before anything is final.
It is also a complete LaTeX editor without the agent:

ul.li: Continuous PDF preview with SyncTeX in both directions, dark mode and search
Errors, warnings and bad boxes explained in plain English, with quick fixes
Completion for commands, environments, labels and citations; snippets; spell checking
Hover previews of references, citations and rendered math
Project outline, command palette, quick open, search and replace across the project
Session restore, recovery of unsaved changes, local history and a git gutter

description.p: Building documents needs a TeX distribution with latexmk. The agent is optional: Lemma works with Claude Code, Codex and other agents that speak the Agent Client Protocol, or with the Anthropic API and your own key.

screenshot.caption: An agent's edits as hunks to accept or reject, beside the agent pane

description.p: The zeta release: recovery of unsaved changes, find and replace in the file, more errors explained, and much faster large documents, projects and reviews. It is the first release for Windows.
